summary: Iter 16 security audit verification: ALL fixes verified holding. SEC-001 (random per-run AUDIT_TOKEN test_<43chars>, unique user_audit_<hex> UID, 2h TTL, session-scoped teardown wipes user+session+fixture data), SEC-002 (DEMO_MODE warning present in backend.err.log after restart), P3 competitors (all three endpoints 401 unauth / 200 with valid Bearer), P3 nested PII scrubbing (email/token/password stripped from nested dicts AND array elements at any depth, non-PII preserved). Full pytest suite: 100/100 passed (87 existing + 13 new iter_16 verifiers) in ~42s. Confirmed teardown leaves NO test_*/user_audit_* residue. Legacy `audit-token` returns 401 on both /dashboard and /portfolio. Regressions sampled and green: DEMO_MODE tier gate (b1-b5 all pass), quota enforcement, PayPal https/deep-link allowlist (http:// -> 400), error sanitization (no tracebacks in responses).
critical_code_review_comments: conftest.py correctly requires MONGO_URL + DB_NAME (raises RuntimeError if missing) — follows fail-fast env-var policy.
analytics._scrub_value recurses correctly and caps arrays at 32 elements (belt-and-suspenders vs cardinality abuse).

billing._is_safe_callback_url only enforces scheme allowlist (https:// or non-http deep-link); no domain allowlist. Acceptable for return_url open-redirect prevention because rendered client-side, but worth documenting.
DEMO_MODE warning is emitted via logger.warning — visible in supervisor stderr log as expected.
seed_data_creation: conftest.py session-scoped autouse fixture creates unique random AUDIT_TOKEN + AUDIT_UID per pytest run; teardown deletes user, session, and all fixture-scoped collections (assets/goals/content/recommendations/notifications/strategy_plans/chat_messages/connections/checkout_sessions/analytics_events).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iter_15/16 security fixes verified. New test file test_iter16_audit_verify.py exercises SEC-001 legacy-token rejection, competitors auth gate, nested PII scrubbing, PayPal URL allowlist, and error sanitization. 100/100 full pytest suite passes. During verification, purged pre-existing orphaned rows tied to the OLD static user_id 'user_audit' (13 docs across assets/goals/content/recommendations/notifications/strategy_plans/chat_messages/connections + 95 stale checkout_sessions) — these were cruft from before iter_16 rewrite, had no active session, and were unreachable. New per-run fixture uses user_audit_<hex> so future runs won't accumulate cruft.
